backdrop-hero-vertical.prompt: An abstract backdrop for a title card. Soft pale sage green paper texture, a faint network of thin connected lines and small nodes drifting across it, deep forest green accents. No text, no letters, no logos, no people, no user interface. Calm, matte, print-like, heavily negative space in the upper two thirds.

backdrop-close-dark.prompt: An abstract backdrop for a closing card. Very dark forest green, almost black, with a faint dot grid and one soft pool of lime green light in the lower right. No text, no letters, no logos, no people. Matte, calm, heavily negative space.

shopfront-texture.prompt: A warm illustrated interior of a small West African retail shop at dusk, shelves of stock, soft lamplight, seen from a distance, painterly and slightly abstract. No recognisable faces, no text, no signage, no logos.
